clauses.scope_note: Applies to the Helix Platform. Customer may not use, transfer, export, or re-export it to an Embargoed Country, to or by a national or resident thereof, or to or by a Designated National. The text describes the relevant embargoed-country and designated-person lists but does not reproduce them.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the destination or person is an Embargoed Country or a national or resident of one, or is a Designated National, as specified in the clause.

clauses.scope_note: Customer must comply with all United States export laws and assumes sole responsibility for obtaining any required United States government export licenses to export or re-export the Helix Platform.
clauses.condition_explanation: The obligation applies to Customer in connection with use of the Helix Platform; any required export license must be obtained for the relevant export or re-export.

coverage_notes: The supplied chunk covers lines 143–196 only; no operative grant of permission to use, copy, modify, distribute, or otherwise exploit the Helix Platform appears in these lines. Do not infer such permission from this chunk.
The export restriction depends on lists that may change without notice; their contents are not supplied here.
Other provisions in the chunk concerning liability, dispute resolution, assignment, notices, and general contract administration do not establish ASC permissions or restrictions and are omitted.
